outcome: The first edge recorded here is the defect, not the behaviour: a start past the end exited 2 -- the right code -- while saying 'no TrueHD access unit or E-AC-3 syncframe found', which is false of a file holding 126 895 access units. That complaint belongs to an empty or unframed file. It now says how long the stream actually is: '--start 99999 s is past the end of the stream, which is 105.746 s long (126895 access units, 5075800 samples)', held by a_start_past_the_end_of_the_stream_names_its_own_cause. An empty file, an unframed file, and a run with no --start were re-checked and still get the original complaint.
reading: 9 starts across 6 titles: every started decode is the byte-identical tail of a full decode, every announced sample is truthful (the byte offset is exactly the announced sample count times 24 bytes per frame, 8 channels of 24-bit), and every exit code equals the one the full decode of the same clip returns -- 7 where the clip is a truncated head, 2 at the append in concat-pi-shaun, 0 where the stream is whole. The WAVE header declares what was written, not the length of the stream.
